no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee meeting was convened for this application, as there were no public health issues raised that would benefit from a public discussion or that required the expert opinions of the Committee. In addition, the safety profile of the drug is deemed acceptable for the indicated population of patients.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the Lutathera (NDA208700) application. The FDA multidisciplinary review states the Division did not obtain the advice of the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because there were no public health issues warranting public discussion and the drug's safety profile was deemed acceptable. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven changes to the approval.
